steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Jesus taught "Love your neighbour as yourself" (Mark 12:31) and the Parable of the Good Samaritan (Luke 10:25-37) shows that Christians must help anyone in need, regardless of who they are. The local church puts this teaching into practice.

steps.title: RS Exam Tips — The Role of the Church
steps.body: 1. For The Role of the Church questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Role of the Church to its real-world impact on believers and society

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Explain two ways the local church serves the community. | "The Church should focus on worship, not social action." Evaluate this statement.

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: 1) Food banks — many churches run food banks that provide emergency food supplies to people in poverty. The Trussell Trust, a Christian charity, runs over 1,200 food banks. steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always refer to specific sources of authority (scripture, sacred texts, religious leaders) Explain contrasting beliefs — different views within and between traditions Use key terminology precisely (e.g. tawhid, atonement, sanctity of life) For 12-mark evaluation questions, consider both sides before reaching a justified conclusion Link beliefs to their impact on individuals, communities and society Acknowledge diversity — no religious tradition has a single, uniform view
